#### Without the smallest patches (6.43 ml)

As the smallest patches at the fixed and relative disturbance had the same 
disturbance level, I rerun the analysis to see if it's robust to taking off 
these patch sizes. 

```{r}
ds_metaecosystems_without_6.43 = ds_metaecosystems %>%
  filter(ecosystem_size_ml != 6.43)
```

<details>
<summary>Prepare & plot data for analysis</summary>
```{r}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_metaecosystems_without_6.43 %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(metaecosystem_ID,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_metaecosystems_without_6.43 %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>%
  filter(time_point %in% time_points_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected)),
         connection == "connected" | 
          ecosystems_combined %in% unconnected_metaecosystems_selected) %>%
  mutate(conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")))
```

</details>

<details>

<summary>Create model</summary>

```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(size = ecosystem_size_ml,
         disturb_type = volume_disturbed_across_sizes) %>%
  mutate(size = as.factor(size),
         day = as.factor(day))

# Define formula

formula <- as.formula(paste(response_variable_selected, 
                            "~",
                            "size * conn * disturb_type +",
                            "(1 | time_point) +",
                            "(1 | baseline)")) %>%
  print()


# Create model 

model <- glmmTMB(formula,
                 data = data_for_analysis,
                 family = tweedie(link = "log"),
                 dispformula = ~ bioarea_mm2_per_ml)
car::Anova(model, type = "III")
```

```{r}

# --- SHOW MODEL SUMMARY --- #

print(summary(model), digits = 3)
```

```{r}

# --- CODE MODEL CONSTRASTS --- #

# Estimate marginal means (least-squares means)

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * disturb_type * size,
                         adjust = "sidak",
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

emmeans_output

# Give a name for each level which you want to compare

uncon_fixed_9 = c(1, rep(0,11)) 
con_fixed_9 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,10)) 
uncon_relative_9 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,9)) 
con_relative_9 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,8)) 
uncon_fixed_15 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,7)) 
con_fixed_15 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,6)) 
uncon_relative_15 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,5)) 
con_relative_15 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,4)) 
uncon_fixed_45 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,3))
con_fixed_45 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,2))
uncon_relative_45 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,1))
con_relative_45 = c(rep(0,11), 1)

# Compute the contrasts

contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("9.00 ml fixed" = con_fixed_9 - uncon_fixed_9,
                                   "15.00 ml fixed" = con_fixed_15 - uncon_fixed_15,
                                   "45.00 ml fixed" = con_fixed_45 - uncon_fixed_45,
                                   "9.00 ml relative" = con_relative_9 - uncon_relative_9,
                                   "15.00 ml relative" = con_relative_15 - uncon_relative_15,
                                   "45.00 ml relative" = con_relative_45 - uncon_relative_45),
                     type = "response")

nested_contrasts <- contrast(contrasts,
                             method = list(
                               "Difference in effects at 9.00 ml" = c(1, 0, 0, -1, 0, 0),
                               "Difference in effects at 15.00 ml" = c(0, 1, 0, 0, -1, 0),
                               "Difference in effects at 45.00 ml" = c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, -1)))

# Tidy up contrasts

upper_CI = (confint(contrasts)$asymp.UCL - 1) * 100
lower_CI = (confint(contrasts)$asymp.LCL - 1) * 100

contrasts = contrasts %>%
  as.data.frame(.) %>%
  mutate(ratio = round(ratio, 2),
         percentage = (ratio-1)*100,
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         lower.CL = round(lower_CI, 2),  # Lower confidence limit
         upper.CL = round(upper_CI, 2),  # Upper confidence limit
         z.ratio = round(z.ratio, 2),
         p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  select(contrast, 
         percentage, 
         lower.CL,
         upper.CL,
         SE, 
         z.ratio, 
         p.value)

contrasts$" " <- ""
contrasts$" "[contrasts$p.value < 0.05] <- "*"
contrasts$" "[contrasts$p.value < 0.01] <- "**"
contrasts$" "[contrasts$p.value < 0.001] <- "***"

# Tidy up nested contrasts

upper_CI = (confint(nested_contrasts)$asymp.UCL - 1) * 100
lower_CI = (confint(nested_contrasts)$asymp.LCL - 1) * 100

nested_contrasts = nested_contrasts %>%
  as.data.frame(.) %>%
  mutate(ratio = round(ratio, 2),
         percentage = (ratio-1)*100,
         lower.CL = round(lower_CI, 2),  # Lower confidence limit
         upper.CL = round(upper_CI, 2),  # Upper confidence limit
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         z.ratio = round(z.ratio, 2),
         p.value = round(p.value, 3)) %>%
  select(contrast,
         percentage,
         lower.CL,
         upper.CL,
         SE,
         z.ratio,
         p.value)

nested_contrasts$" " <- ""
nested_contrasts$" "[nested_contrasts$p.value < 0.05] <- "*"
nested_contrasts$" "[nested_contrasts$p.value < 0.01] <- "**"
nested_contrasts$" "[nested_contrasts$p.value < 0.001] <- "***"
```
</details>

```{r}
plot.metaecos.contrasts(contrasts,
                        response_variable_selected)
```

<summary>Model residuals</summary>

```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

# Simulate residuals from the fitted model

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, 
                                      n = 1000) 

# Test for overdispersion in the model to check if variance exceeds mean

testDispersion(simulationOutput)

# Plot Q-Q and Residuals vs Fitted plots

plot(simulationOutput)

# Plot residuals against specific predictors to check if residuals are 
# independent of these variables - fixed variables

plotResiduals(simulationOutput,
              form = data_for_analysis$size)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput,
              form = data_for_analysis$conn)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput,
              form = data_for_analysis$disturb_type)

# Plot residuals against specific predictors to check if residuals are 
# independent of these variables - random variables

plotResiduals(simulationOutput,
              form = data_for_analysis$metaecosystem_ID)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput,
              form = data_for_analysis$time_point)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput,
              form = data_for_analysis$baseline)

# Test for outliers 

testOutliers(simulationOutput)

# Test for zero inflation not accounted for
 
testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)
```
